task: There is a 10x-genomics single cell CellRanger data with RNA-seq (feature bc matrix) and TCR-seq (contig annotations) data. There are two samples, LT5 and LN5. There's also a jupyter notebook with data loading, preprocessing, and clonotype/clonotype-cluster definition already set up (nucleotide-identity clonotypes and amino-acid-similarity clonotype clusters are already defined). Build upon. Perform clonal expansion analysis. Use breakpoints 1, 2, 5 cells for grouping expanded clonotypes. In which sample (LT5 or LN5) there are more clonotypes? In which sample there are relatively more expanded clonotypes? In which sample there are more clonotypes with number of cells between 2 and 5? Calculare alpha-diversity (normalized shannon entropy) for LN5 sample. How many distinct clonotypes (clone_id) belong to a convergent clonotype cluster?
